# myst

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-001 — Admonitions render as coloured callouts](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-001.md) — When a writer uses a MyST admonition of any kind, with a custom title, as a dropdown or nested, the Studio SHALL show it as a coloured callout with its title and body.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-002 — Context tags render as readable panels](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-002.md) — When a writer pastes prompt-style context tags, the Studio SHALL show each as a readable panel and SHALL NOT lose its content or run it as HTML.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-003 — Definition lists and inline text roles are typeset](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-003.md) — When a writer uses definition lists, subscript, superscript, abbreviations or keys, the Studio SHALL show them typeset.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-004 — Reference roles show where a link goes](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-004.md) — When a writer links to a heading, figure, table, equation or label with a reference role, the Studio SHALL show a link whose target is visible.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-005 — Build-dependent constructs appear as labelled placeholders](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-005.md) — When a document uses citations, a bibliography or an unknown directive, the Studio SHALL show an inert, labelled placeholder for it.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-006 — Maths is typeset offline and bad formulas stay readable](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-006.md) — When a document contains inline, display or aligned maths, the Studio SHALL show it typeset without network access, and SHALL keep an invalid formula readable.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-007 — Sphinx configuration gaps are reported before building](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-007.md) — When a Sphinx project's configuration does not enable MyST syntax used in a document, the Studio SHALL tell the author which syntax is missing and where, without running the configuration file.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-008 — Figure width and alignment show in the preview](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-008.md) — When a writer sets a figure's width or alignment, the Studio SHALL show the figure at that width and alignment.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-009 — Label anchors are visible and linkable](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-009.md) — When a document defines a label, the Studio SHALL show an anchor icon next to its target and let the writer link to it.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-010 — A label can be renamed safely from its anchor](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-010.md) — When a writer renames a label from its anchor icon, the Studio SHALL apply it as one undoable edit, or explain why it refuses.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-011 — Grid cards adapt to the pane width](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-011.md) — When a writer lays out content with grid cards, the Studio SHALL show the cards in a layout that adapts to the pane width.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-012 — Toctree shows linked documents and marks missing ones](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-012.md) — When a document contains a table of contents directive, the Studio SHALL list the documents it names as links and mark missing ones.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-013 — Table directives render as ordinary tables](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-013.md) — When a document uses list, caption or CSV table directives, the Studio SHALL show them as ordinary tables.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-014 — A closable banner warns about configuration syntax warnings](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-014.md) — When the Sphinx configuration check finds syntax warnings, the Studio SHALL show a non-intrusive closable banner that opens the Problems view, including in Restricted Mode.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
